[[Insatiable Vakar]] is a [[paragon]] [[boss]] hired by [[White Mantle]] for [[War in Kryta|war]] against the [[Shining Blade]], and is a member of the [[Peacekeeper]]s.

== Notes ==
* Additional [[Peacekeeper Marksman|Peacekeeper Marksmen]] and [[Silent Peacekeeper]]s will appear when Vakar is approached. 
** It is easier to defeat this boss if you either pull Vakar away from his potential allies ''or'' trigger their appearance and pull them away from Vakar.
* If [[Defend North Kryta Province]] is active, Vakar may be killed by [[titan]]s before you reach him.
